blocks.text: β-elimination woh reaction hai jis mein alkyl halide ke β-carbon (halogen wale carbon ke bilkul saath wala carbon) par laga hydrogen atom aur saath wale carbon par laga halogen atom, dono halogenoalkane se nikal jate hain. Yeh tab hota hai jab base halogenoalkane ke β-hydrogen par hamla kare. Halogen ya to usi waqt nikalta hai ya hydrogen ke nikalne ke baad. Is tarah substitution product ki bajaye alkene ka molecule milta hai. Yeh reactions substitution reactions ke saath saath hote hain aur aksar un se muqabla (compete) karte hain. Nucleophilic substitution ki tarah elimination bhi do mechanisms se ho sakta hai: E2 ya E1.
E2 mechanism mein base β-hydrogen par hamla karta hai aur usi waqt leaving group nikal jata hai, aur carbon-carbon double bond ban jata hai. Ek qadam wala E2 mechanism neeche diya gaya hai.

blocks.alt: Base- se bromoethane ke beta H ki taraf mura teer, us C-H bond se C-C bond ki taraf mura teer, aur C-Br bond se Br ki taraf mura teer; natija ethene + H-Base + Br-.
blocks.caption: E2 mechanism: bromoethane (kitab ke PDF safha 81 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke E2 khaake mein C–Br bond se Br tak ka mura teer (curly arrow) nahi chhapa. Br apne bond ke electrons le kar nikalta hai, is liye hamare khaake mein yeh teer shamil kiya gaya hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Base β-carbon ka H kheenchta hai; us C–H bond ke electrons do carbons ke darmiyan doosra bond (C=C) banate hain; aur isi waqt Br apne bond ke electrons le kar nikal jata hai. Teeno kaam ek hi qadam mein hote hain.

E2 reaction bimolecular hai aur is ki raftaar alkyl halide aur base, dono ki concentrations par munhasir hai. SN2 ki tarah E2 ki molecularity (qadam mein hissa lene wale molecules ki tadaad) bhi do hai, aur yeh second order kinetics dikhate hain.

E1 mechanism mein, SN1 ki tarah, pehla qadam substrate ka sust ionization hai jis se carbocation banta hai. Doosre qadam mein base β-hydrogen par hamla karta hai aur product ke taur par alkene banti hai.

blocks.alt: Qadam 1: 2-bromo-2-methylpropane (C par delta+, Br par delta-) equilibrium teeron (slow) se 3 darje (tertiary) ka carbocation + Br- deta hai. Qadam 2: Base- se beta H ki taraf mura teer, aur us C-H bond se musbat carbon wale bond ki taraf mura teer, tez (fast), 2-methylpropene + H-Base.
blocks.caption: E1 mechanism: 2-bromo-2-methylpropane (kitab ke PDF safha 81 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke E1 khaake (Step 1) mein carbocation ke ek methyl group ko 'CH₂' likha gaya hai. Sahi CH₃ hai, kyun ke carbocation (CH₃)₃C⁺ ke teeno groups CH₃ hain, jaisa hamare khaake mein hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Step 1 mein Br⁻ sust raftaar se nikalta hai aur 3° (tertiary) carbocation banta hai. Step 2 mein base β-carbon ka H hatata hai aur C–H ke electrons musbat carbon ki taraf ja kar C=C banate hain; 2-methylpropene milti hai.

E1 unimolecular mechanism hai; is ki raftaar sirf alkyl halide ki concentration par munhasir hai. Primary halogenoalkanes aam taur par E2 se aur tertiary halogenoalkanes E1 se chalte hain. Secondary halogenoalkanes solvent ke intikhab (choice) ke mutabiq E2 aur E1 dono dikha sakte hain.

blocks.prompt: Kya 1-bromo-2,2-dimethylpropane, (CH₃)₃C–CH₂Br, elimination karta hai? Wajah batayein.
blocks.explanation: Nahi: β-carbon, yani C(CH₃)₃, par koi hydrogen nahi, is liye base ke paas hatane ke liye koi β-hydrogen nahi.

items: β-elimination: β-H aur X nikal kar alkene banti hai; substitution ke saath muqabla hota hai.
E2: ek qadam, Rate = k[Alkyl halide][Base], second order. E1: carbocation ke zariye, rate sirf alkyl halide par.
Primary: E2; tertiary: E1; secondary: dono (solvent ke mutabiq).
